pageTitle: River Profile Studio — Cross-sections, SOBEK Y-Z & profiling · Mahfujur Rahman Joy
problem: Convert surveyed river cross-sections into SOBEK CRDS ... lt yz definitions. Check and edit points visually, orient left bank first, add vertical walls, and export a clean PROFILE.DEF. Runs 100% in your browser.
method: Cross-Section Inspector (Y-Z): interactively inspect and edit elevations and distances, add or delete specific survey points, select custom left and right bank codes for orientation.
Datum shift to Z (m): MSL → PWD in Bangladesh is typically +0.46 m. Section names in SOBEK become Prefix + ID.
Vertical wall at beginning & end: None (SOBEK standard extension); Add wall of size / height (+H m); Wall to fixed level (Z = … m).
Bank crest trimming (optional — off by default): keeps only the main channel between the natural bank crests.
Output: without a file, a clean new PROFILE.DEF is written. With an existing file, matching section names are updated in place.

Thalweg & Longitudinal Profiler (L-Profile): automatically tracks the lowest bed points to plot longitudinal thalweg profiles and 2D alignment maps. Shows Thalweg Bed Profile, Left Bank Crest, Right Bank Crest, Mean Bed Gradient (S₀) and an optional Water Surface; Reach Stations Checklist & Local Gradients; Export Thalweg CSV and Export 3D GeoJSON.
data: Drop an Excel or CSV file (.xlsx · .xls · .csv · .txt) with Cross-section ID, Distance Y (m), Level Z (m) and an optional bank / data code; optional Easting / Longitude (X), Northing / Latitude (Y) and River / Reach / Khal name for the thalweg profile and map. 'Load sample survey' loads a built-in sample (9 sections in 2 reaches).
limitations: Produces SOBEK 2.1x CRDS … ty 10 … lt yz blocks. Verify in SOBEK Data Edit before model execution.

samples.label: In-app button 'Load sample survey' (built-in sample: 9 sections in 2 reaches, Kalibari Khal and Bhola Khal; loaded automatically when the page opens)
